meta.title: Whizzzest — Wanzai fireworks shows, heritage, food & travel guide
meta.description: A visitor guide to Wanzai, Jiangxi, with fireworks at Wanzai Ancient City, local food, cultural traditions and suggested itineraries.

hero.title: One encounter, ten thousand years endure
hero.subtitle: Explore Wanzai’s fireworks, living traditions, local food and landscapes.

features.title: Centuries of fireworks
features.desc: Wanzai’s fireworks tradition reaches back to the Tang dynasty and continues in the county’s workshops and public displays.

features.title: Distinctive local flavors
features.desc: Try the Six Bowls of Wanzai, edible lily bulbs and Luocheng rice noodles, specialties of western Jiangxi.

features.title: From the old town to the forest
features.desc: Walk the lanes of Wanzai Ancient City, visit Zhushan Cave or head to Jiulong Forest Park.

themes.title: Discover Wanzai
themes.desc: Start with Wanzai’s traditional arts, local cooking or the workshops behind its fireworks displays.

items.title: Living heritage
items.desc: Explore Wanzai’s fireworks craft, Desheng Drum music, Kaikou Nuo ritual theater and Xiabu ramie weaving.

items.title: Local flavors
items.desc: Discover Wanzai’s banquet dishes, Luocheng rice noodles and edible lily products.

items.title: Fireworks industry
items.desc: See how a craft once practiced in family workshops grew into a major local industry.

experience.title: Experience Wanzai
experience.desc: Try the fireworks simulator or read fiction and essays by local writers.

cats.desc: Try the Six Bowls, Luocheng rice noodles and dishes made with local lily bulbs.
